title: Web UI: viewer handoff + badge + API server + WS
description:
Aggiungere la lettura/clear degli handoff nella Web UI + API server + WS.

## Stato attuale (codice)
- plan-server: route file-based `GET /handoff`, `DELETE /handoff` (serve.ts:767-777). Web UI: nessuna UI handoff. WS hub esiste (WsHub) per live update.
- Componenti recenti: `CopyableBadge`/`EntityPathBadge` (components/ui/badges.tsx), Work Tree rows (components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx), phase-row (components/phases/phase-row.tsx), responsive mobile già sistemato.

## Work items
1. **plan-server API**:
   - `GET /handoffs` → `store.listHandoffs()` (lista pending: compositeRef, updatedAt, firstLine).
   - `GET /phases/:id/handoff` → full text.
   - `PUT /phases/:id/handoff` `{content}` → `setPhaseHandoff`.
   - `DELETE /phases/:id/handoff` → `clearPhaseHandoff`.
   - Rimuovere/deprecare vecchie `GET/DELETE /handoff` (file-based).
   - WS events su write/clear (handoffUpdated, handoffCleared).
2. **Web UI — badge**: indicatore su fasi con handoff pendente in Work Tree (work-tree-rows.tsx), lista fasi (phase-row.tsx), phase-detail. Usare stile coerente con badge esistenti (CopyableBadge/EntityPathBadge).
3. **Web UI — viewer**: pannello/vista "Handoffs" — lista pending (compositeRef + data + prima riga), click → leggi handoff full (modal o route dedicata), pulsante **Clear** (delete-on-resume da UI). Read + clear (write opzionale, scrivono gli agenti).
4. **WS live**: aggiornamento badge/lista al evento handoffUpdated/Cleared.
5. API client (lib/api.ts): funzioni `listHandoffs`, `getPhaseHandoff`, `clearPhaseHandoff`.

## Rischi
- Responsive mobile del viewer (modal scroll già fixato con 100dvh — riusare).
- Plumb WS eventi handoff.
- Rimozione vecchie route /handoff non deve rompere client vecchi (versione parallela o deprecation).

## Comportamenti da preservare
- Responsive mobile (max-width 640px), `grid-cols-1`, `min-w-0`, `overflow-wrap:anywhere`.
- Badge compositi copyable (CopyableBadge).
- Composite ID (P00x(F00x)).

tasks.title: plan-server API: /handoffs + /phases/:id/handoff + WS events
tasks.description:
**P5 — API server.**

## Attuale
plan-server route file-based `GET /handoff`, `DELETE /handoff` (serve.ts:767-777). WsHub esistente.

## Da fare in packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts
1. `GET /handoffs` → `store.listHandoffs()` (lista pending).
2. `GET /phases/:id/handoff` → `{content, updatedAt}` (`getPhaseHandoff`).
3. `PUT /phases/:id/handoff` body `{content}` → `setPhaseHandoff`.
4. `DELETE /phases/:id/handoff` → `clearPhaseHandoff`.
5. Deprecare/rimuovere vecchie `GET/DELETE /handoff` (file-based) — o tenerle come redirect temporaneo.
6. WS events: `handoffUpdated {phaseId}`, `handoffCleared {phaseId}` broadcast via WsHub.

## Edge case
- Phase non trovata → 404.
- Content vuoto su PUT → clear equivalente (o errore).

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Entity-scoped handoff API + WS events in packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts.\n\nRoutes (replaced file-based GET/DELETE /handoff):\n- GET /handoffs -> { handoffs: store.listHandoffs() } (pending list with compositeRef + firstLine + updatedAt).\n- GET /phases/:id/handoff -> { content, updatedAt } (getPhaseHandoff + phase.handoffUpdatedAt); 404 if phase missing.\n- PUT /phases/:id/handoff body {content} -> setPhaseHandoff; empty/whitespace content -> clearPhaseHandoff (clear equivalent). Returns {content, updatedAt} or {cleared:true}.\n- DELETE /phases/:id/handoff -> clearPhaseHandoff; returns {cleared:true}; audit timestamp preserved.\nAll mutating routes broadcast handoffUpdated/handoffCleared + phases-updated + plan-rendered.\n\nWS events (packages/plan-server/src/ws-hub.ts): added { type: "handoffUpdated"; data: { phaseId } } and { type: "handoffCleared"; data: { phaseId } } to WsEvent.\n\nValidation: pnpm -r build clean; pnpm check clean; 16/16 API smoke assertions green (round-trip PUT/GET/DELETE, list compositeRef P001(F001)+firstLine, 404 missing phase, empty-PUT=clear, audit kept, old /handoff routes gone -> SPA fallback HTML not legacy JSON).

**Completion summary:**
Done. Web UI client (api.ts) + types + WS live update + visual check.\n\nTypes (packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/types.ts): Phase += handoff + handoffUpdatedAt; replaced file-based HandoffDocument with HandoffSummary {phaseId, compositeRef, updatedAt, firstLine} + PhaseHandoff {content, updatedAt}.\n\napi.ts (packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts): normalizePhase defaults handoff/handoffUpdatedAt; replaced getHandoff/deleteHandoff (file-based) with listHandoffs(), getPhaseHandoff(phaseId), setPhaseHandoff(phaseId, content), clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId).\n\nroot.tsx: loader now listHandoffs() (was getHandoff); AppShell handoffExists={handoffs.length>0} (was handoff.exists).\n\nlive-sync.tsx: added handoffUpdated + handoffCleared to the WS switch → scheduleRevalidate (in addition to the phases-updated broadcast the server already emits).\n\nhandoff.route.tsx: converted from file-based to entity-scoped — two-pane viewer (pending list with CopyableBadge compositeRef + firstLine + date | detail with FormattedText content + Clear button). Subscribes to agent-plan:ws-event (handoffUpdated/handoffCleared) → re-fetch. Empty state "No pending phase handoffs". (This is the T4 viewer; built here to keep the build green after removing the file-based client.)\n\nValidation: pnpm -r build clean; pnpm check clean; Puppeteer visual @390px green (overflow 0, Pending(1), P001(F001) copyable badge, firstLine "Resume context", Clear→empty state, 0 console/request errors). Web-ui bundle synced to plan-server/web-ui-dist + pi-adapter/web-ui-dist via copy-web-ui.sh.

tasks.title: Web UI: viewer handoff (lista pending → leggi full → clear)
tasks.description:
**P5 — viewer Web UI.**

## Da fare
1. Vista/pannello "Handoffs": lista pending (compositeRef P00x(F00x) + data + prima riga) via `GET /handoffs`.
2. Click su una voce → leggi handoff full (modal o route dedicata; riusare ModalShell con 100dvh per mobile scroll).
3. Pulsante **Clear** (delete-on-resume da UI → `DELETE /phases/:id/handoff`).
4. Read + clear (write opzionale — scrivono gli agenti; se implementi write, `PUT`).
5. FormattedText per renderizzare il contenuto handoff (markdown) con `.formatted-text` overflow rules.

## Edge case
- Lista vuota → empty state "Nessun handoff pendente".
- Mobile: modal scroll (100dvh + overscroll-contain).

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Entity-scoped handoff viewer (routes/handoff.route.tsx) — built during the T2 client integration (the file-based getHandoff was removed, so the route was rewritten to compile against the new API). Satisfies the full T4 spec.\n\nViewer (two-pane route, responsive):\n- Left: pending list from GET /handoffs (loader) — each item shows CopyableBadge compositeRef (P00x(F00x)) + firstLine + updated date; click to select.\n- Right: full handoff content via getPhaseHandoff(selectedId) rendered with FormattedText (className="formatted-text" → overflow-wrap anywhere, min-width 0). Header shows CopyableBadge + "Updated <date>" + firstLine as title.\n- Clear button → clearPhaseHandoff → empty state.\n- WS live: subscribes to agent-plan:ws-event (handoffUpdated/handoffCleared) → version bump → re-fetch list + selected. (live-sync.tsx also scheduleRevalidate on these events.)\n- Empty state: "No pending phase handoffs" when list is empty.\n- Defaults to selecting the first handoff (so content is visible immediately).\n\nMobile: route (not modal) — page scrolls naturally; 100dvh/ModalScroll not needed. overflow: none verified at 390px.\n\nValidation: build + check clean; Puppeteer @390px green — 2 handoffs render, Pending(2), first selected content renders, FormattedText present, click P3 switches content, Clear → empty state, 0 overflow, 0 console errors. (The "list items 4" report is a nested-button artifact: each item's CopyableBadge renders an inner button → 2 items × 2 = 4; Pending(2) confirms 2 real entries.)
